name: com.octopuscommunity.octopus_sdk_for_unity
description: Unity wrapper for the Octopus SDK Android and iOS libraries.

samples.description: Example of minimal integration by using Octopus Authentication.

Data-driven push notification handling, symmetric on iOS and Android. iOS uses Unity Mobile Notifications for APNs token and tap detection (no native file required). Android ships a native FirebaseMessagingService (Java + .androidlib manifest) that displays Octopus data-only messages in the background and routes the tap.
Fetch groups, batch follow/unfollow sync, and open a specific group feed.
